q510737.placeNote: The Suda says he was born at Samosata, but that may mix him up with Lucian of Samosata; the pin is Antioch, where he taught.

q313011.dateNote: His dates are not known: he lived in the 3rd or 4th century. The year shown is only a placeholder.
